name: Agentic Organization
description: Self-hosted agentic organization management platform. Gives an agent persona its organizational context — task delegation (A2A), a working journal, read-only queries against operator-registered databases, and policy read-back — exposed as MCP tools over a single JSON-RPC endpoint. Open source (MIT); every deployment is operated independently and issues its own credentials.

extensions.description: The endpoint speaks MCP (protocol 2025-06-18): initialize, tools/list, tools/call.

personaToken.description: Persona token issued by the deployment operator via POST /workstation/persona-token. See https://agent.fab.engineering/auth.md.

skills.name: Read org policies
skills.description: Return the company, department and agent-scope policies that currently constrain this persona.

skills.name: Delegate to another agent
skills.description: Hand a sub-task to a specialist agent in the same organization and wait for a human-approved result (A2A).

skills.name: Write to journal
skills.description: Append a markdown entry to the persona's working journal.

skills.name: Query a registered database
skills.description: Run a read-only SQL query against a database the operator registered for this agent.

skills.name: Web search
skills.description: Search the web for a query.
